name: Quote
description: A standout quotation with attribution and an optional portrait; the brand's decoration and portrait frame arrive through slots.
whenToUse: A quotation that earns its own beat: a customer's words, a leader's framing, a line from the brief. 'standout' makes it the moment; 'editorial' sets it quieter beside a portrait. The brand's echo lines, quotation mark or portrait framing come through the quoteDecoration and portraitFrame slots. Never invent quotations; use supplied ones only.
